String fileNameCheck(String fileName) {
  if (fileName == null || fileName.isEmpty) return 'Invalid file name';
  
  final parts = fileName.split('.');
  if (parts.length < 2) return 'Invalid file name';

  String ext = parts.last;
  for (int i = 0; i < parts.length -1; i++) {
    if (i > 0) {
      final prevPart = parts[i-1];
      final part = parts[i];
      if (!part.contains(RegExp(r'^(?:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+)$')) ||
          !prevPart.contains(RegExp(r'^\d+$'))) {
